incorrect_inferences: The first pass treated the seven-second line as a possible active bomb window. Source shows the seven-second value is refuge power duration; the bomb has an eight-second motion period. The original uncertainty was appropriate from idle dialogue, but the exact timing hypothesis was not the mechanic.
changed_judgments: Cooperation rises from 1 to 2 because Pac must hold OPEN while Isp crosses, then Isp’s RESCUE latch permits Pac to leave; this is a distinct role and one handoff.
Execution rises from 2 to 3 because both heroes traverse several separated raised platforms with jumps around a floor-level lethal hazard.
Hazards resolves from null to 2 because the authored bomb harms both heroes on contact, while the refuge route offers a practical safe approach.
Timing remains 2, but the rationale changes: the repeated refuge pause is a safe three-second window; the seven-second dialogue is not a bomb countdown and the bomb runs on a separate cycle.
Recovery resolves at 2 as a plausible bomb mistake ends the run and requires restarting the pad sequence; no actual failure/retry was observed, limiting confidence.

Reasoning and solution clarity remain 2: roles and sequence are visible enough to test, but the held OPEN-to-RESCUE dependency and safe refuge timing are not fully explained without the optional hint.

single_operator_note: A single operator would have to alternate between movement groups while maintaining Pac on OPEN and monitoring the bomb and refuge cycle; that interference is outside the two-human baseline.
